Custom Shopify App Development

The Shopify App Store has over 10,000 apps. But when your business has specific operational requirements — a pricing engine that doesn't exist, a fulfilment workflow that no off-the-shelf app handles, or an integration with a proprietary system — a custom Shopify app is the right answer. Agentix is a specialist Shopify app developer delivering Shopify private apps, Shopify app development services and Shopify app solutions built specifically for your workflows. We build private Shopify apps that solve the exact problem, integrate cleanly with your admin and stack, and are maintained as your business evolves.

Why it matters

A store engineered to convert — not just to look good.

If you're an ambitious ecommerce brand, custom shopify app development should compound revenue at every visit. Here's what we help you achieve:

  • Lift conversion rate across mobile and desktop.
  • Cut friction from browse to checkout.
  • Build on a fast, scalable foundation that grows with you.

We combine conversion-first design, clean development and performance into stores that are a pleasure to use and built to scale.

What's included

Everything you get with Custom Shopify App Development.

01

Private Shopify app development

Fully custom admin-embedded apps built to your exact specification — custom reporting dashboards, B2B pricing engines, inventory management tools, fulfilment workflows and more.

02

Shopify Functions

Custom business logic using Shopify Functions — discount rules, delivery method customization, payment filtering, order validation and cart transformations that go beyond native settings.

03

Checkout Extensions

Custom UI components embedded in the Shopify checkout — upsell widgets, custom fields, trust badges, loyalty point display and more — built using Shopify's official Checkout Extensions API.

04

Webhook & event-driven automation

Event-driven automation triggered by order creation, payment events, inventory changes and customer actions — connecting your Shopify store to your full operations stack in real time.

05

Admin UI Extensions

Custom interfaces embedded directly in the Shopify admin — giving your team purpose-built tools without leaving the platform they already use every day.

06

App maintenance & Shopify API updates

Ongoing maintenance and version compatibility as Shopify evolves its APIs — because a custom app that breaks with a platform update is a liability, not an asset.

How it works

A clear path from audit to growth.

Step 01

Scope

Detailed requirements gathering — what the app does, what it integrates with, what it replaces, and what success looks like in measurable terms.

Step 02

Architect

Technical design — API architecture, data model, UI/UX for admin interfaces, and integration points defined before code is written.

Step 03

Build

Development with unit testing, integration testing and QA at every stage.

Step 04

Deploy & maintain

App deployment (private or Shopify Partners), documentation, team training and ongoing maintenance.
